title: Generalized Convexity and Smoothness via Conjugate Duality, with Applications to Deep Network Training
abstract: arXiv:2608.09523v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Stochastic gradient descent (SGD) and its variants train deep neural networks (DNNs) effectively in practice, yet classical optimization theory does not fully explain this success: conventional analyses rest on differentiability, convexity, and smoothness, assumptions that DNN objectives routinely violate. We close this gap by generalizing convexity and smoothness, through Legendre functions and convex conjugation, into a unified optimization framework for DNN training. We introduce \(\mathcal{H}(\psi)\)-convexity and \(\mathcal{H}(\Psi)\)-smoothness, a single formalism that encompasses convex and non-convex as well as smooth and non-smooth objectives and reveals a natural duality between generalized convexity and smoothness. Building on these notions, we derive generalized gradient descent (GD) and generalized SGD via convex conjugation. translated_title: 基于共轭对偶的广义凸性与光滑性及其在深度网络训练中的应用
translated_abstract: 随机梯度下降（SGD）及其变体在实践中能够有效地训练深度神经网络（DNN），然而经典优化理论并不能完全解释这一成功：传统分析依赖于可微性、凸性和光滑性等假设，而深度神经网络的目标函数往往违反这些假设。我们通过勒让德函数和凸共轭，将凸性与光滑性进行推广，构建了面向深度神经网络训练的统一优化框架，从而弥合了这一理论缺口。我们引入了 \(\mathcal{H}(\psi)\)-凸性与 \(\mathcal{H}(\Psi)\)-光滑性，这一统一的形式化体系同时涵盖了凸与非凸、光滑与非光滑的目标函数，并揭示了广义凸性与光滑性之间的自然对偶关系。基于这些概念，我们通过凸共轭导出了广义梯度下降（GD）和广义随机梯度下降（SGD）。我们证明了广义梯度下降能够取得恰好为 1 的最优学习率，并建立了……
tldr: 该论文通过勒让德函数与凸共轭提出了统一的 \(\mathcal{H}(\psi)\)-凸性与 \(\mathcal{H}(\Psi)\)-光滑性框架，突破了传统优化理论对可微性、凸性和光滑性的假设限制，并为深度神经网络训练建立了新的理论基础，包括证明广义梯度下降的最优学习率恰好为 1。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a unified framework of \(\mathcal{H}(\psi)\)-convexity and \(\mathcal{H}(\Psi)\)-smoothness via Legendre functions and convex conjugation, relaxing the conventional assumptions of differentiability, convexity, and smoothness, and establishes a new theoretical foundation for deep network training, including generalized gradient descent with an optimal learning rate of exactly 1.
